correctness.rationale: With harmonic angular bases t^{|m|/2}e^{imθ}, the m-th projection is rank one. The real radial multiplier commutator is the 2x2 skew block with singular value sqrt(E_m u²-(E_m u)²), twice per Fourier mode. The m=0 mode contributes 2, each ±m contributes 4. Beta(m+1,α+1) moments and boundary continuity yield m^βσ_m→|v(1)|κ, with κ²>0 by strict beta-moment variance/Γ log convexity. Counting all fourfold angular blocks gives N(s)~4(c/s)^{1/β}, and hence s_n~4^β c n^{-β} without monotonicity; power summation gives pβ>1 and logarithmic residue 4c^{1/β}. The v(1)≠0 and β>0 hypotheses are indispensable. Independently recomputed rational Beta moments for α=0 β=2 at m=1,3,20,100,1000; m⁴ variance grows toward 20 (19.7067 at m=1000). Finite check is not the infinite argument.
